notesHint: Optional. For you and your team.

suppliers.intro: The shops and companies you buy from. Enter each one once.
suppliers.newDescription: Their name and, if you like, how to reach them.
suppliers.nameHint: In any language, the way you and your team call them.

empty.title: No suppliers yet
empty.body: Add the shops and companies you buy from most. Their phone, email and TRN are optional. Then pick them when you enter a purchase.
empty.viewer: Nothing has been added here yet.

suppliers.trnHint: Optional. The 15-digit tax number on their invoices.
suppliers.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number: digits, spaces, +, - or brackets.

purchases.intro: What you buy, the way you buy it. Final purchases set the cost of your materials.
purchases.intro_food: What you buy, the way you buy it. Final purchases set the cost of your ingredients and supplies.
purchases.intro_factory: What you buy, the way you buy it. Final purchases set the cost of your raw materials.
purchases.booksClosed: The books are closed up to {{date}}. Nothing dated on or before it can be finalized or reversed.

empty.title: No purchases yet
empty.body: Enter what you bought, in the packs you bought it in, with the price you paid. When you finalize a purchase, the average cost of each material updates.
empty.body_food: Enter what you bought, in the packs you bought it in, with the price you paid. When you finalize a purchase, the average cost of each ingredient or supply updates.
empty.body_factory: Enter what you bought, in the packs you bought it in, with the price you paid. When you finalize a purchase, the average cost of each raw material updates.
empty.viewer: No purchases have been entered yet.

filters.noMatchesHint: Change the filters or clear them.

editor.intro: A draft changes nothing. When you finalize it, its goods come into your stock and your material costs update.
editor.intro_food: A draft changes nothing. When you finalize it, its goods come into your stock and the costs of your ingredients and supplies update.
editor.intro_factory: A draft changes nothing. When you finalize it, its goods come into your stock and your raw material costs update.
editor.vatNotReclaimableHint: Turn this on if you can't get this VAT back. It then counts in the cost of the goods.
editor.itemsHint: One line per material, in the unit or pack you bought it in.
editor.itemsHint_food: One line per ingredient or supply, in the unit or pack you bought it in.
editor.itemsHint_factory: One line per raw material, in the unit or pack you bought it in.
editor.noMaterials: Add your materials first, then enter what you bought.
editor.noMaterials_food: Add your ingredients and supplies first, then enter what you bought.
editor.noMaterials_factory: Add your raw materials first, then enter what you bought.
editor.noMaterialAccess: Your role doesn't include materials, so you can't pick them here. Ask the owner if you need it.
editor.deliveryHint: Delivery on this invoice is shared over the materials by their amount and counts in their cost. A separate delivery bill is an expense.
editor.deliveryHint_food: Delivery on this invoice is shared over the ingredients and supplies by their amount and counts in their cost. A separate delivery bill is an expense.
editor.deliveryHint_factory: Delivery on this invoice is shared over the raw materials by their amount and counts in their cost. A separate delivery bill is an expense.
editor.addDocumentDiscount: Add a discount on the whole purchase
editor.documentDiscountHint: Shared over the materials by their amount, before VAT.
editor.documentDiscountHint_food: Shared over the ingredients and supplies by their amount, before VAT.
editor.documentDiscountHint_factory: Shared over the raw materials by their amount, before VAT.
editor.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Open it again to see the latest version.
editor.copiedFrom: This draft corrects a purchase that was reversed. Fix it, then finalize it.
editor.closedEarlier: The books are closed up to {{date}}. To finalize, pick a later date.
editor.closedToday: The books are closed up to today ({{date}}). You can save a draft and finalize it tomorrow, or open the books in Settings.
editor.savedNotFinalized: Saved as a draft, not finalized: {{reason}}

errors.materialGone: This material isn't in your list any more. Pick another.
errors.materialGone_food: This ingredient or supply isn't in your list any more. Pick another.
errors.materialGone_factory: This raw material isn't in your list any more. Pick another.
errors.unitGone: This unit isn't one of this material's any more. Pick another.
errors.qtyTooLarge: This quantity is more than BizCost can count.
errors.qtyTooSmall: This quantity is too small to count.
errors.discountOverLine: The discount is more than this item's price.
errors.discountOverNet: The discount is more than the materials' total.
errors.discountOverNet_food: The discount is more than the total of the ingredients and supplies.
errors.discountOverNet_factory: The discount is more than the raw materials' total.
errors.noMaterial: Add at least one material: delivery and discounts are shared over the materials.
errors.noMaterial_food: Add at least one ingredient or supply: delivery and discounts are shared over them.
errors.noMaterial_factory: Add at least one raw material: delivery and discounts are shared over the raw materials.
errors.needMaterial: Add at least one material before you finalize.
errors.needMaterial_food: Add at least one ingredient or supply before you finalize.
errors.needMaterial_factory: Add at least one raw material before you finalize.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.hint: A photo or PDF of the invoice or receipt, up to 10 MB.
receipts.removeBody: The file is deleted. The purchase stays as it is.

confirm.finalizeBody: Its goods come into your stock and the average cost of {{names}} updates.
confirm.finalizeNote: A final purchase can't be edited. If something is wrong later, you can reverse it or correct it.
confirm.finalized: Purchase finalized. The average cost of {{names}} is updated.
confirm.finalizeClosedToday: The books are closed up to today, so nothing can be finalized today. You can finalize it from tomorrow, or once the books are opened again in Settings.
confirm.reverseBody: It will be as if it was never entered: its goods leave your stock and the average cost of {{names}} goes back to what it would be without it.
confirm.reverseNote: It stays in your list, marked reversed. Costs already worked out for earlier records stay as they are.
confirm.reverseClosed: The books are closed up to today, so nothing can be reversed today. You can reverse it from tomorrow, or once the books are opened again in Settings.
confirm.reverseDated: The reversal is dated {{date}}, the first day after the books-closed date.
confirm.reversed: Purchase reversed. The average cost of {{names}} is updated.
confirm.correctBody: It is reversed and a copy opens as a new draft. Fix the copy and finalize it. Until then, the average cost of {{names}} leaves this purchase out.
confirm.corrected: Purchase reversed. Here is the copy to fix.
confirm.discardBody: It's deleted with its receipts. Nothing else changes: a draft never touched your costs.

view.title: Purchase of {{date}}
view.costTotal: What the goods cost in all:
view.vatInCost: The VAT is part of the cost of the goods (it can't be reclaimed).
view.vatOutOfCost: The VAT isn't part of the cost of the goods (you reclaim it).
view.reversedNote: Reversed on {{date}}. It no longer counts in your costs.
view.draftNote: This is a draft: it changes nothing until it's finalized.
view.draftLocked: This draft has prices your role doesn't show, so it can't be edited here.
view.notFoundBody: It was discarded, or the link is wrong.

returns.title: Returns and credit notes
returns.hint: Goods you sent back to the supplier, and price cuts they gave you.
returns.reverseFirst: To reverse this purchase, reverse its returns and credit notes first.
returns.returnDescription: What you sent back. It leaves your stock at the price you paid for it.
returns.creditDescription: A price cut on this purchase, without sending goods back.
returns.split: One amount for the whole purchase
returns.splitHint: Shared over the items by what's left of their amount.
returns.pickReturn: Enter how many to return of at least one item.
returns.pickCredit: Enter an amount for at least one item.
returns.beforePurchase: This date is before the purchase. Choose its day or a later one.
returns.confirmReturnBody: The goods leave your stock at the price you paid for them, and the average cost of {{names}} updates.
returns.confirmReturnAmount: Leaving your stock: {{items}}, at the price you paid ({{amount}} before VAT). The average cost of {{names}} updates.
returns.confirmReturnAmountNoVat: Leaving your stock: {{items}}, at the price you paid ({{amount}}). The average cost of {{names}} updates.
returns.confirmCreditBody: The cost of {{names}} goes down by the amount credited, and their average costs update.
returns.confirmCreditAmount: The cost of {{names}} goes down by {{amount}} before VAT, and their average costs update.
returns.confirmCreditAmountNoVat: The cost of {{names}} goes down by {{amount}}, and their average costs update.
returns.confirmNote: Once final, it can't be edited, only reversed.
returns.returnFinalized: Return finalized. The average cost of {{names}} is updated.
returns.creditFinalized: Credit note finalized. The average cost of {{names}} is updated.
returns.reverseBody: It will be as if it was never entered, and the average cost of {{names}} goes back.
returns.reversed: Reversed. The average cost is updated.
returns.reversedNote: Reversed on {{date}}. It no longer counts in your costs.
returns.discardBody: It's deleted. Nothing else changes: a draft never touched your costs.
